content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing issues with the [product_name] module. I want to send an SMS to the module to activate, for example, output 1 on either the communication module or the base module. I have managed to configure it so the module sends me an SMS when input 1 is set to 1.
Thanks, I'll give it another try this weekend.

A new question posted by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread titled 'Setup and change user details of [product_name] with [product_name] BM or [product_name] TDE.' Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The thread focuses on challenges setting up the [product_name] module for incoming SMS commands to control outputs. While outgoing SMS alerts were successfully configured, the user finds it difficult to enable output activation via received SMS, highlighting complexity and/or insufficient documentation for two-way SMS control configuration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] module to process incoming SMS commands to control outputs as dependably as it sends alerts, and they desire a setup process that is straightforward or better documented.
